mechanism: Cyclobenzaprine causes CNS depression while modafinil promotes wakefulness, creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects and potential unpredictable CNS outcomes; modafinil may inhibit CYP1A2 which metabolizes cyclobenzaprine.
action: Monitor for reduced cyclobenzaprine efficacy or paradoxical CNS effects; consider alternative muscle relaxant or wakefulness agent if combination necessary; counsel on avoiding concurrent use if possible.
